messages.subject: Retro prep and action item: decision log (issue #42)
messages.body_text:
Team,

Ahead of tomorrow's retro (Wednesday 10:00), two things.

1. Action item for Rahul: set up a decision log in the mobile repo, one entry per decision with the date, who decided, and the rationale. Tracked here: https://github.com/orbit-app/mobile/issues/42. Due Friday, October 2nd. Backfill it from the kickoff, the design review and the Meridian recap.

2. Everyone: add one went-well and one didn't-go-well as a comment on issue #42 before 10:00 tomorrow, so we don't spend the retro remembering.

Aditya

messages.subject: Re: Retro prep and action item: decision log (issue #42)
messages.body_text:
Accepted. Decision log by Friday the 2nd, in docs/decisions.md, one file, and I'll link each entry to the issue. Backfilling from the kickoff notes first; the Razorpay one is going to make a good first entry.

Rahul

messages.subject: Re: Retro prep and action item: decision log (issue #42)
messages.body_text:
Comment added to #42.

Also, for the record, since this is the date everyone has been watching: the UPI flow is done as of last night, one-time and autopay mandates, tested against the Razorpay sandbox. Monday the 28th, as promised in my email on the 17th. The PayU swap continues, still October 1st.

Priya

messages.body_text:
Done, comment's on the issue. Mine for went-well is the checklist as a baseline. For didn't-go-well: I can't remember why we chose the drawer without looking it up, which is sort of the point of Rahul's log.

Sana
